thread:
Noah (partnerships): SentinelEdge preview confirmed for week of Jul 7. Need NDA signed, customs paperwork, and a concise go/no-go checklist. Can we split owners? @Priya for logistics, @Ethan for hardware, @Mina for benchmarks, @Ruth for legal.
Priya (partner-ops): I'll manage shipping and lab intake. Partner says units ship DDP, ETA Mon afternoon. Please confirm rack U and peak current.
Ethan (hw-eng): Hardware notes: 2 nodes, 1U each, expected 1.0kW steady per rack. Firmware tags: sent-edge-2026-06 (stable) and sent-edge-2026-07rc (perf fixes). Recommend baseline on stable then upgrade. Need serials and firmware checksums.
Mina (bench): I'll own validation. Proposed minimal matrix: 4096 single-stream latency, batch4 throughput, short 3h soak, and 300-sample quality spot-check vs redwood/v1.2. Acceptance: p99 within 10% and quality delta <1%. Also include a micro-benchmark to isolate quant kernel timing.
Ruth (legal): NDA draft received. I'll redline telemetry and embargo language; request partner confirm no access to raw request payloads. Target: countersigned NDA by Tue EOD.
CalendarBot: Event created: "SentinelEdge Preview - Lab Week" Mon-Fri Jul 7-11. Invitees: Noah, Priya, Ethan, Mina, Ruth.
Noah (partnerships): Also need a short feedback template that includes perf summary, infra notes, firmware list, regression flags, and owners for follow-ups. Who can draft?
Mina (bench): I'll draft the feedback one-pager and include a perf table (p50/p95/p99), latency histogram link, and triage checklist. Runner snippet for infra: 
./bench_runner --model redwood/v1.2 --seq 4096 --batch 1 --out s3://redwood-preview/sentinel/metrics.json
Will export token timings and p99/p99.9.
Ethan (hw-eng): If we see PCIe or driver variance, capture dmesg, lspci, and kernel module versions. I'll reserve isolated GPU nodes in case passthrough is needed.
Priya (partner-ops): Shipping labels and commercial invoice uploaded to the shared drive. Posting tracking once carrier confirms pickup.
Ruth (legal): Sent redlines to partner counsel, flagged telemetry retention and embargo window. Waiting for countersign.
Noah (partnerships): Action items: Ruth - NDA by Tue; Priya - shipping + rack by Mon; Ethan - firmware/kernel capture by Tue; Mina - bench doc + runner by Mon AM. I'll run day-zero sync Mon 09:00.
Mina (bench): Noted. Potential blocker to flag: sent-edge-2026-07rc alters quant scheduling; will run micro-benchmarks and flag regressions early.
Noah (partnerships): Thanks team. Keeping this thread as the primary coordination channel. :white_check_mark:
